lumen.description:
Lumen is an open-source VPN and proxy client.

Add servers manually or import configurations and subscriptions from a link, file, clipboard, or QR code. Manage servers, check latency, and keep subscriptions up to date automatically.

Features:
• Supports VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, and more.
• Split tunneling: choose which apps use or bypass the VPN.
• Routing rules for domains and IP addresses.
• Configurable DNS and local SOCKS/HTTP proxy.
• Quick Settings tile, widgets, traffic statistics, and latency checks.
• Light and dark themes, plus additional appearance options.

Lumen does not provide VPN servers or subscriptions. You will need your own server configuration or a subscription from a VPN provider.
